QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_15

question.text: For a Cat III AIF, a change in the investment strategy of the scheme requires:

answer.text: Simple majority of unit holders by headcount
Consent of at least 75% of unit holders by value
SEBI approval only, no investor consent needed
Consent of at least two-thirds of unit holders by value of their investment

explanation.text: The Logic: A change in investment strategy must be made with consent of at least TWO-THIRDS of unit holders BY VALUE of their investment. Two-thirds (by value) is the threshold; 75% is reserved for winding-up / in-specie / dissolution. The Trap: Option A invents a headcount test. Option B uses the wrong threshold (75% is for winding-up). Option C skips investor consent entirely. Note: The workbook fixes the two-thirds-by-value rule for strategy change; running parallel material-PPM and 75% waiver consent processes is operational guidance not part of the syllabus.
